vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope: game model — board state, win detection, validation

narrative.Overview: Implement the core game model: 3×3×3 board state, all 49 win lines, draw detection, and move validation. This is the dependency for all other scopes.
narrative.Requirements: FR-3 (move placement), FR-4 (move validation), FR-5 (win detection — all 49 lines), FR-6 (draw detection).
narrative.Tasks:
1. Define Board class: 27-cell flat list (indexed z*9+y*3+x), EMPTY/X/O markers.
2. Compute and store WIN_LINES: 27 axis-parallel + 18 face-diagonal + 4 space-diagonal = 49 lines.
3. Implement is_winner(player) — check all 49 lines.
4. Implement is_draw() — all cells filled, no winner.
5. Implement make_move(cell, player) — validate occupied/out-of-range, apply move, return True/False.
6. Implement copy() — immutable copy for AI search.
7. Write tests/test_game.py covering all 49 win lines (explicit), draw, invalid moves.
narrative.Acceptance: pytest tests/test_game.py passes with all 49 win lines tested individually. Coverage >= 90% for game.py.
